newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak c.bank board okays steps for fx risk, banks.
newsitem.headline: Slovak c.bank board okays steps for fx risk, banks.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia's (NBS) governing board said on Friday it approved measures at its regular meeting that would automate calculation of foreign exchange risk and bank loan registrations.

The NBS said in a statement the board approved a "practical framework" for a project called "risk management and an open foreign exchange position" and a project named "registry of bank loans and guarantees."

"The (first) project creates conditions for an automated system of securing and assessment of data necessary for the management of risk introduced by an open foreign exchange position and the monetary structure of foreign exchange assests and liabilities," the statement said.
The NBS will use the system starting on April 30.
"The (registry) project will secure technological and programme conditions for automating the bank loan registry and guarantees registration," the statement said but did not include further details.
NBS officials were not immediately available for comment.

Slovak interbank money market dealers have been watching for a possible reverse repo rate cut or some administrative measures after Prime Minister Vladimir Meciar's statement earlier this week that measures would be taken to lower rates.
